name: soft-door-box
task: Open the door, then, if possible, pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(door_open) hard captures the command 'Open the door'; Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) hard keeps the stated order ('then') intact even though the box pickup itself is optional; Existence(target_picked_up) soft matches the preference cue 'if possible', which scopes only the box pickup and leaves the order and the door goal hard. Since the soft Existence forces nothing, door_open is a lone commanded step and its hard Existence is needed, not redundant.

texts: Do not pick up the target box before the door has been opened.
If possible, pick up the target box.
